sentences.japanese: すぐに君は寮で生活するのになじみますよ。
sentences.english: You will soon adjust to living in a dormitory.

sentences.japanese: あの二人の少年は寮の同じ部屋を共有している。
sentences.english: Those two boys share the same dormitory room.

sentences.japanese: 「なあ、寮の門限って何時だっけ？」「２１時よ」「やばい、走らないと間に合わないぞ」
sentences.english: "Hey, when do the dorms lock up?" "9 o'clock." "Whoops, if we don't run we won't make it!"

sentences.japanese: あ、みんなには内緒だよ？寮を夜中に抜け出すのは厳罰だからね？
sentences.english: Oh, that's a secret, OK? Because slipping out of the dorm in the night is severely punished.

sentences.japanese: 寮の暖房が故障してるんです。
sentences.english: Our dorm's heating system isn't working properly.
